{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment (e.g., -0.20 or -0.25) over recent days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is significantly above recent 5-10 day average, reduce by 5-15% for next period.",
    "Increase downward bias when sentiment shifts from positive to negative (e.g., 0.00 → -0.20 or -0.25).",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility: if true outcome deviates >10% from forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5-10%.",
    "If sentiment history includes multiple consecutive 0.00 values, assume low volatility and adjust forecast toward historical mean.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.33 or 0.50), allow slight upward bias but cap at +5% above recent 15-day average to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For long-term forecasts (e.g., 30-day), apply smoothing: reduce forecast volatility by 20-30% if sentiment is neutral or negative."
  ]
}
